intent: Warn once at boot when a supported pre-rename name supplies the selected configuration, and retire only the five individually ruled dev-only hardware shims and the refused Session 0 EOS compiler before v1.0.0.
invariants: CH_, CONTROL_HUB_, AGENT_HOME, x-ch headers, ch-backup and all 52 redirects continue through v1.0.0 with their established precedence.
A legacy value that wins selection yields one boot warning naming keys and replacements only; a losing legacy value or PS-only boot yields none; secrets and paths are never printed by this warning.
Only the five Q-013/tooling-10b repository shims and org-11's refused EOS compiler retire now; installed data-directory copies and same-directory ps-* twins remain.
The two org-11 compiler-only b15 test identities are removed by explicit exception and itemised; all other test identities and gates remain.
rollback: Restore a removed repository shim only if its ruled caller inventory is refuted. Keep aliases and the warning until the post-v1.0.0 retirement; restore the compiler only under a separately accepted decision that addresses its obsolete matrix and governance writes.
verify_line: Real isolated boots with each winning legacy family warn once without a value and start; PS-only boots do not warn; five ruled shims and the refused compiler are absent while installed copies and ps-* twins work, retirement records exist, and x-ch headers and all redirects still pass acceptance.
